description: SCIM filters (RFC 7644 section 3.4.2.2) as the SCIM server reads them: parseFilterExpression -> FilterNode (attribute paths lowercased, schema URNs stripped except the enterprise extension, which stays one segment), invalid filters throw IamError invalidFilter (400). `matches` cases evaluate the parsed filter against three rendered users (ids u1, u2, u3) and list the ids that pass. id, externalId and members.value compare case-exactly; everything else ignores case.
